en.title: Board Tokens and Adjacency Bonus
en.description:
T means a cell has a token and E means an empty cell. Each cell with a token earns its corresponding points, and each pair of adjacent cells that both have tokens earns 1 extra point. Find the total score.

The standard input/output format was compiled by CSWork; value ranges marked "this site" are this site's judging conventions.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100), the second line contains n points values (1..1000), and the third line contains a TE string of length n.
en.output: Output the answer required by the problem.
en.explanation: Example 1: the token cells score 3+2+3=8, and the last two cells earn a bonus of 1, for a total of 9. Example 2: the scores are 2+1+2=5, and two adjacent pairs earn a bonus of 2, for a total of 7. Example 3: a base of 8 points plus three adjacency bonuses gives a total of 11.
hints: Sum the points of all T cells, then count the adjacent TT pairs.
